name: Racing Demon
description: Racing Demon is a patience card game that involves tableau, foundations, stock. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

variations.name: Jokers
variations.description: Two jokers per deck; joker stands for any card. When playing a joker onto a foundation the player must announce rank and suit before moving it. On work piles no announcement needed.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Jokers variant does not change engine constants; overrides not mapped.

variations.name: Nerts pile size
variations.description: Some play with 12 cards (11 face down, one up) or 11 cards (10 face down, one up) in the Nerts pile instead of 13.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Nerts pile size is a deal/setup variant; overrides not yet mapped.
